chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Jamhur, from his father, from Yunus, from Abdul Hameed ibn Awwaz, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Regarding a man who has wealth with him, and a year passes over it, then he acquires other wealth before a year passes over the first wealth. He (peace be upon him) said: 'When a year passes over the first wealth, he should pay zakat on both of them together.'

key_terms.زَكَّاهُمَا: he purified them (paid zakat on them)

ai.seo_question: How to calculate zakat when new wealth is acquired before the first year of existing wealth is complete?
ai.summary: In this ruling from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), the principle of 'consolidation' (jam') is applied, where new wealth acquired before the initial hawl completes is merged with the original capital for zakat calculation. This reflects the Shia juristic consensus that the timing of the lunar year determines the liability, ensuring the total accumulated wealth is purified in a single payment. It underscores the practical application of zakat as a mechanism for spiritual cleansing of one's entire estate rather than isolated transactions.

en.hubeali: Ali bin Muhammad, from Ibn Jamhour, from his father, from Yunus, from Abdul Hameed Bin Awwaz,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said regarding the man who happens to have some wealth with him, and a year passes by over it. Then he attains other wealth before a year passes by upon the former wealth. Heasws said: ‘When a year passes by upon the former wealth, he should purify (pay Zakāt) the whole of it’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from ibn Jumhur from his father from Yunus from ‘Abd al-Hamid ibn ‘Awwad who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam,

about a man who has a certain asset which remains in his possession for one year, then he gains other assets before the passing of one year. He (the Imam) said, ‘When one year passes with the first asset, pay Zakat for both assets.’”
